allowed_mechanism: Validate every resident checkpoint file against the bound full manifest once, then expose that exact directory read-only to the project container by bind mount or symlink. Project-specific scripts, outputs, mutable caches, and any candidate overlay remain in a separate project directory.
forbidden: writing project artifacts into the shared checkpoint
weakening or skipping full content validation
reason: The lab owns the retained bench and its exact content-addressed checkpoint. Re-copying identical immutable weights per project exhausted disk before CUDA and defeats the campaign's explicit warm-state reuse contract.
